Checking whether the pyproject name is used as a Python import and scanning the UI for visible titles/headers:

Presenting the rebrand scope and where it fits into the plan. In plan mode we can't edit the plan file; here’s the addition to include. --- ## Rebrand: ElixirTrials → CriteriaMunger (product name) and UI "HITL" → CriteriaMunger **Intent**: Use **CriteriaMunger** as the product/app name everywhere users see it. Keep **ElixirTrials** only where it clearly means the company (e.g. copyright, author emails). In the UI, show **CriteriaMunger** instead of "HITL" or "HITL System". ### 1. Product name: ElixirTrials → CriteriaMunger (docs and config) | Location | Change | |----------|--------| | [mkdocs.yml](mkdocs.yml) | `site_name`: "CriteriaMunger — Clinical Trial Criteria Extraction"; `site_author`: "ElixirTrials Team" (company) or "CriteriaMunger" as preferred. | | [docs/index.md](docs/index.md) | Title and "What is ElixirTrials?" → "What is CriteriaMunger?"; body text "ElixirTrials" → "CriteriaMunger" (product). | | [docs/onboarding.md](docs/onboarding.md) | "Get ElixirTrials running" → "Get CriteriaMunger running"; any other product references. | | [docs/architecture/index.md](docs/architecture/index.md) | "ElixirTrials is a monorepo" → "CriteriaMunger is a monorepo". | | [docs/status/index.md](docs/status/index.md) | "ElixirTrials components" → "CriteriaMunger components". | | [docs/code-tour/index.md](docs/code-tour/index.md) | "key code paths in ElixirTrials" → "key code paths in CriteriaMunger". | | [docs/development/gemini-vertex-auth.md](docs/development/gemini-vertex-auth.md) | "ElixirTrials supports two backends" → "CriteriaMunger supports two backends". | | [docs/kaggle-writeup.md](docs/kaggle-writeup.md) | Title and body: product name → "CriteriaMunger"; keep author emails (noah@elixirtrials.com, etc.) and company name where it means the company. | | [docs/assets/custom.css](docs/assets/custom.css) | Comment "ElixirTrials Brand Theme" → "CriteriaMunger" if that comment is user-facing. | | [README.md](README.md) | Heading and description: "ElixirTrials" → "CriteriaMunger"; keep clone URL if it stays under ElixirTrials org. | | [MEDGEMMA_INTEGRATION.md](MEDGEMMA_INTEGRATION.md), [AGENTIC_WORKFLOW.md](AGENTIC_WORKFLOW.md) | Product references "ElixirTrials" → "CriteriaMunger". | | [.env.example](.env.example) | Comment "ElixirTrials supports" → "CriteriaMunger supports". | | [notebooks/criteria_extraction_demo.ipynb](notebooks/criteria_extraction_demo.ipynb) | "ElixirTrials pipeline" → "CriteriaMunger pipeline". | | [scripts/validate-model-endpoint.py](scripts/validate-model-endpoint.py), [scripts/setup-local-models.sh](scripts/setup-local-models.sh) | Printed/banner text "ElixirTrials" → "CriteriaMunger". | | [Makefile](Makefile) | Banner "ElixirTrials" → "CriteriaMunger". | | [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml) | `name = "elixirtrials"` → `name = "criteriamunger"` (or `criteria-munger`) for consistency; no Python imports use this today. | | [LICENSE](LICENSE) | Keep "Copyright 2025 ElixirTrials" (company). | ### 2. UI: show "CriteriaMunger" instead of "HITL" | Location | Change | |----------|--------| | [apps/hitl-ui/src/App.tsx](apps/hitl-ui/src/App.tsx) | Header `

HITL System

` → `

CriteriaMunger

`. | | [apps/hitl-ui/src/screens/LoginPage.tsx](apps/hitl-ui/src/screens/LoginPage.tsx) | "Clinical Trial HITL System" → "CriteriaMunger" (or "CriteriaMunger — Clinical Trial Criteria"). | | [apps/hitl-ui/index.html](apps/hitl-ui/index.html) | `HITL UI - Human in the Loop` → `CriteriaMunger` (or "CriteriaMunger - Clinical Trial Criteria"). | | [apps/hitl-ui/e2e/example.spec.ts](apps/hitl-ui/e2e/example.spec.ts) | `toHaveTitle(/ElixirTrials /i)` → `toHaveTitle(/CriteriaMunger/i)`. | | [apps/hitl-ui/README.md](apps/hitl-ui/README.md) | "# HITL UI" → "# CriteriaMunger UI" (and optional note: "App package: hitl-ui"). | **Leave unchanged (technical identifiers)**: Directory name `apps/hitl-ui`, `package.json` name `"hitl-ui"`, mkdocs nav key `hitl-ui`, CI paths `apps/hitl-ui/**`, and docs that refer to the app as "hitl-ui" for code paths (e.g. "File: apps/hitl-ui/...") so as not to break tooling. ### 3. Docs: user-facing "HITL" → CriteriaMunger where it means the product | Location | Change | |----------|--------| | [mkdocs.yml](mkdocs.yml) | Nav label "Grounding, Structuring & HITL Review" → "Grounding, Structuring & Review" or "… & CriteriaMunger Review"; "HITL Flow" → "Review Flow" or "CriteriaMunger Flow". | | [docs/index.md](docs/index.md) | "Diagrams … HITL, agent" → "… review, agent" or "… CriteriaMunger". | | [docs/onboarding.md](docs/onboarding.md) | "see the HITL UI" → "see the CriteriaMunger UI"; "HITL review page" → "CriteriaMunger review page". | | [docs/journeys/*.md](docs/journeys/) | "HITL UI", "HITL Review" in prose → "CriteriaMunger" or "CriteriaMunger review" where user-facing; keep "hitl-ui" in sequence-diagram participant names and file paths if you want to preserve code references. | | [docs/diagrams/hitl-flow.md](docs/diagrams/hitl-flow.md) | Title "HITL Flow" → "Review Flow" or "CriteriaMunger Review Flow"; diagram label "HITL Review" → "CriteriaMunger Review". | | [docs/status/index.md](docs/status/index.md) | "HITL review UI" → "CriteriaMunger UI"; "future HITL use" → "future manual (HITL) use" or leave as-is if it’s a technical term. | | [docs/development/gemini-vertex-auth.md](docs/development/gemini-vertex-auth.md) | "For the HITL UI authentication" → "For CriteriaMunger authentication". | | [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md) | "React/Vite HITL UI" → "React/Vite CriteriaMunger UI"; keep "apps/hitl-ui" in paths. | --- **Summary**: - **Product name**: Replace "ElixirTrials" with "CriteriaMunger" in docs, README, mkdocs site_name, notebooks, scripts, Makefile, and optionally pyproject name; keep "ElixirTrials" only for company (e.g. LICENSE, author emails). - **UI**: Use "CriteriaMunger" in the header (App.tsx), login title (LoginPage.tsx), and HTML title (index.html); update e2e title assertion and app README. - **Docs**: Use "CriteriaMunger" (or "CriteriaMunger review") wherever the product or UI is described; keep folder/package name `hitl-ui` and code paths unchanged. If you want this merged into your existing MkDocs audit plan, we can treat it as a new top-level section (e.g. "8. Rebrand to CriteriaMunger") and then execute the full plan (MkDocs fixes + rebrand) in one pass. If you’d rather do the rebrand only, we can limit the next step to the files above.
